fusions.name: Sever the Tie
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A chop through that strand that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lanyard Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls a hatchet around you on a cord. It deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pendant Blade
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. A hatchet on a cord swings beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Carried On the Cord
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, the hatchet swings on its cord to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
